Don't get me wrong, I'm not saying he was doing anything malicious ("I'm gonna make everybody freak out and think this is actually a bomb") or that this was some big ruse to invoke good PR for certain groups. If he was dishonest about his motive for bringing it in, a key part of the story, it calls into question the rest of his account. This whole story is one big "he said, she said" with no real evidence for either side, so if one side appears dishonest it boosts the credibility of the other side.
